title: ATCA study of Small Magellanic Cloud supernova remnant 1E 0102.2-7219
question: What are the radio continuum morphology, spectral index, polarisation, magnetic field strength, and interstellar environment (HI and CO) of the young Small Magellanic Cloud supernova remnant 1E 0102.2–7219?

recipe.goal: Determine SNR expansion centre and radio/X-ray radii
recipe.method: Apply Minkowski tensor analysis tool BANANA to 5500 MHz, 9000 MHz, and Chandra broadband images, smoothing the line density map with a 40-pixel diameter circle. Extract 16 radial profiles in 22.5 deg segments using miriad cgslice and measure radius at the 3-sigma contour cutoff.
key_parameters: 40-pixel smoothing circle; 16 radial profiles of 30 arcsec length every 22.5 deg; 3-sigma cutoff (200 uJy/beam at 5500 MHz; 6e-7 counts/pixel/s for Chandra)

recipe.goal: Measure integrated radio continuum flux densities (including ALMA 108 GHz) and fit spectral index
recipe.method: Extract integrated flux density from radio continuum images (MWA, ASKAP, ATCA, ALMA) by summing pixel brightnesses above 5-sigma local background noise within the SNR area (excluding unrelated point sources) using miriad imfit and Findlay (1966) eq. 24. Fit a power-law weighted least-squares model to flux density vs. frequency (excluding ALMA due to missing short spacings), and create a resolved spectral index map from 2100, 5500, and 9000 MHz ATCA images.
key_parameters: 5-sigma pixel brightness threshold; regridded to 0.3 x 0.3 arcsec^2 pixel size and smoothed to 2.7 x 2.6 arcsec^2 resolution for spectral index map
assumptions: Pure power-law radio spectrum S_nu propto nu^alpha; flux density errors < 10%; ALMA 108 GHz flux excluded from fit due to missing short spacings

recipe.goal: Calculate fractional polarisation, rotation measure, and magnetic field strength
recipe.method: Compute fractional polarisation maps at 5500 and 9000 MHz (5x5 arcsec^2 beam) using miriad impol. Convolve Q and U maps to 4 arcsec resolution and compute RM and intrinsic polarisation angles where polarised S/N >= 10-sigma using rmcalc. Estimate equipartition magnetic field using Urošević et al. (2018) and Arbutina et al. (2012) models, and derive line-of-sight and total shell magnetic field from RM gradient fit and depolarisation in the north-east shell.
key_parameters: 10-sigma S/N threshold in polarised intensity for RM; equipartition inputs: alpha = 0.61, theta = 0.36 arcmin, kappa = 0, S_5500MHz = 0.131 Jy, f = 0.84; RM equation inputs: dl = 5.3 pc, n_e = 14.8 cm^-3, foreground MW RM = +23 rad m^-2
assumptions: Faraday-thin intermixed synchrotron emitting and Faraday rotating plasma (factor of 2 in RM); intrinsic synchrotron polarisation of 71%; compression ratio of 3.7 (combined compression and enhancement factor 4.8)

recipe.goal: Examine HI and ALMA CO morphology around E0102
recipe.method: Construct velocity channel maps, integrated intensity map (160.1-168.9 km/s), and position-velocity diagram of ASKAP HI data, and construct a peak temperature map of ALMA 12CO (J=2-1) line emission overlaid with ATCA 5500 MHz contours.
key_parameters: HI velocity channel integration every 3.9 km/s from 188.5 to 153.3 km/s; HI integrated map over 160.1-168.9 km/s; PV slice Dec -72d01m42.9s to -72d02m02.1s
